SG_OPEN.title: Security Group open to the Internet
SG_OPEN.explanation: Allows 0.0.0.0/0 — anyone on the internet can connect. Violates least privilege.

SSH_EXPOSED.title: SSH exposed to internet
SSH_EXPOSED.explanation: Port 22 open to the world. Attackers can brute-force or exploit SSH.

XSS_SIM.title: Reflected XSS (simulated)
XSS_SIM.explanation: Unsanitized user input shown back to browser. Can trigger malicious scripts.
